allow: PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5510 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $pid5510 = \($c | Select-Object -First 1\).OwningProcess; Stop-Process -Id $pid5510 -Force; "killed $pid5510" } else { "nothing on 5510" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 16; $c2 = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5510 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c2\) { Get-Process -Id \($c2 | Select-Object -First 1\).OwningProcess | Select-Object Id, StartTime | Format-List; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5510/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "HTTP ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } } else { "not up yet" })
